__platform__comment: The Qiling MCU platform used for this operation (e.g., stm32f415)
__target__comment: The specific target profile or algorithm being used (e.g., ASCON)
__plaintext_length__comment: The length of the plaintext input in bytes (e.g., 64 bytes)
__ad_length__comment: The length of the associated data input in bytes (e.g., 16 bytes)
__num_shares__comment: The number of shares used for masking
__pa_rounds__comment: The number of PA rounds (full rounds) in the ASCON algorithm
__pb_rounds__comment: The number of PB rounds (partial rounds) in the ASCON algorithm
__ror_shares__comment: Number of shares rotated in ASCON to mitigate side-channel attacks
__extern_bi__comment: Indicates if external bit interleaving is used
__memory_mappings__comment: Additional memory regions required by the target during emulation
